visualizations.description: Repeated period measurements scatter slightly around 2.05 s

spec.body_markdown: ## Collecting Data You Can Trust\n\nRecord numbers the instant you measure them, never from memory. Always include units. Measure the same way every time, and always run multiple trials rather than relying on one reading. If a result looks off, flag it instead of quietly dropping it.
